scripts.dev: rm -rf dist/chrome && TARGET=chrome vite build --watch --mode development & TARGET=chrome vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --watch --mode development & wait
scripts.dev:firefox: rm -rf dist/firefox && TARGET=firefox vite build --watch --mode development & TARGET=firefox vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --watch --mode development & wait
scripts.build: tsc && rm -rf dist && npm run build:target --target=chrome && npm run build:target --target=firefox
scripts.api:types: uv run --directory ../backend python -m scripts.export_openapi > ../backend/openapi.json && npx -y openapi-typescript@7.13.0 ../backend/openapi.json -o src/lib/api-types.ts
scripts.build:target: TARGET=$npm_config_target vite build && TARGET=$npm_config_target vite build -c vite.content.config.ts
